# Manifestly Checklists

> > Manifestly Checklists is a workflow automation platform that transforms recurring tasks and standard operating procedures into streamlined, trackable checklists with role-based assignments, conditional logic, and team collaboration.

Manifestly Checklists helps teams automate and standardize recurring workflows through intelligent checklist management. The platform supports enterprise features like SAML SSO, role-based access control, and integrations with popular tools like Slack, Microsoft Teams, Salesforce, and Zapier.

## Key Topics

- Workflow Automation
- Checklist Management
- Recurring Workflows
- SOP Software
- Task Assignment
- Role-Based Access Control
- Conditional Logic
- Data Collection
- Team Collaboration
- Slack Integration
